subject: Traffic mirroring sanity gates and migration runway for Dedicated migration
messages:
From: Lena Park <lena@solvexa.com>
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted->Dedicated validation: initial traffic bundle and ask

Diego,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. As discussed, we'd like to run a traffic-mirroring validation against a dedicated pool before committing our reserved capacity. Attached is a 48-hour sample (anonymized) that reflects our peak patterns. Key asks:

- Mirror a 10% traffic slice to the dedicated environment for prefix/KV sanity and throughput profiling.
- Confirm token-level latency percentiles (p50/p95/p99) and per-request cost delta for our mix.
- Validate that prefix caching yields expected reduction in GPU utilization during steady state.

We aim to finalize sizing and sign the commitment by 10/10, so tight timeline. Sending ops contact in cc for availability.

Thanks,
Lena Park
Head of Platform
Solvexa
Attachment: solvexa_traffic_sample.csv (CSV, 2.1MB, anonymized)
From: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Cc: Lena Park <lena@solvexa.com>, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted->Dedicated validation: initial traffic bundle and ask

Team — forwarding Solvexa's sample and timeline. High-level plan I propose:

1) Run a 72-hour traffic-mirroring window with a 10% split (non-invasive) into a dedicated test pool.
2) Enable prefix/KV caching and traffic-aware batching profiles used in staging.
3) Collect per-token latency distributions and GPU util vs baseline hosted.
4) Run a short stress soak (1 hour) at peak QPS to confirm autoscaling and throttles.

Constraints / notes:
- We should avoid any write-path changes; this must be read-only mirroring from Solvexa's proxy.
- Need procurement/PO on file before any billing-impacting throughput (>100k tokens/day).

Marissa — can you attach the traffic-mirroring runbook and propose available dates next week?
Karthik — please confirm the dedicated pool configuration (GPU type / quantization profile) you recommend off the sample and whether a warm cache period is required.
Ben — I'll need an on-call infra lead for the stress soak window.

Diego Fernandez
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: Lena Park <lena@solvexa.com>, diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 11:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted->Dedicated validation: initial traffic bundle and ask

Thanks Diego + Lena — attaching the internal traffic-mirroring runbook and a proposed execution timeline. Highlights:

- Proposed window: 2026-10-05 08:00 - 2026-10-08 08:00 PDT (72 hours).
- Dedicated pool: 4x A5000-equivalent (quantized LLM profile Q2) for initial validation; we can scale up based on early telemetry.
- Metrics to capture: per-token latency (p50/p95/p99), GPU util, avg batch size, KV cache hit rate, and token cost delta.
- Safety gates (fail-open): If p99 latency rises >2x hosted baseline for >10min, traffic mirroring auto-rolls back.
- Billing: we will enable non-billable mirroring for the test period; any production-level sustained traffic after acceptance requires PO.

Action items (owners / ETA):
- Karthik: confirm pool config and whether a warm cache pre-seed (6 hours) is needed — ETA EOD 2026-10-01.
- Ben: infra on-call schedule and stress soak runbook — ETA 2026-10-02.
- Monica: prepare the performance dashboard (shared Drive link in runbook).
- Solvexa: confirm mirror proxy endpoints and provide a signed PO for committed capacity if results look good.

Attachment: traffic-mirroring-runbook-v1.pdf (runbook, 420KB)

Marissa Cole
Technical Program Manager, Customer Onboarding
Redwood Inference

Marissa / Diego,

The plan looks good to us. A few quick notes:

- We can stand up the mirror proxy on our side by 10/04; endpoints will be provided that morning.
- PO attached for the committed capacity if we proceed post-validation (see attachment).
- DocuSign: please send any SOW/annex for signature after the validation gate.

One ask: can Redwood share a short checklist we can run during the warm-cache pre-seed to verify consistent model outputs (sanity + hallucination spot checks)? If you have a small prompt set we usually run, please add it to the runbook.

Thanks,
Lena Park
Head of Platform, Solvexa

Lena — quick status update and next steps: 

- Karthik confirmed the pool config: 4x A5000-eq, Q2 quant profile, warm-cache pre-seed 6 hours. (See runbook v1)
- Ben is on-call for the stress soak on 10/06; infra logs will stream to the shared dashboard.
- Monica populated the sanity prompt set (10 prompts) and added expected output checks to the runbook.
- We scheduled the 72-hour mirror: 2026-10-06 08:00 - 2026-10-09 08:00 PDT (moved one day to accommodate ops).

If everything looks good, we'll aim to deliver a sizing recommendation and committed capacity proposal by 10/12.
